comment: The twenty chord tables are at Myria.cpp:50 to :71; their intervals are reduced to pitch classes and sorted at Myria.cpp:104 to :121, so an interval above an octave folds back. The pool of candidate pitches spans -4V to 5V (Myria.cpp:200 to :207) and is padded an octave at a time if it holds fewer than sixteen notes (Myria.cpp:209 to :214). The inversion CV uses the C remainder operator, so a negative sum gives a negative index; the index is used to offset a start position that is then clamped into the pool, so it does not crash. The shuffle order is saved with the patch.
